content: Events norms: confirmation on RSVP with .ics/add-to-calendar; multi-touch reminders (1 week, 48h, 2-3h before); capacity limits with waitlist (Circle 'Limit RSVPs', Wix, RSVPify); check-in via QR scan or name search (Luma), Express Mode auto check-in, undo check-in; self check-in via link/code/geofence/time window (OneTap, MyAttendanceTracker) as no-hardware alternatives.
